name: Hensel ENYSTAR distribution enclosures
summary: Modular distribution-enclosure system with doors, flanges and mounting accessories.
description: Arrange adjoining enclosures together with their connection flanges and internal mounting components. Door opening and the space to remove covers belong in the overall layout.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The STEP collection separates boxes, doors, rails and other accessories; check that each selected component belongs to the intended assembly.
A collection of empty enclosures is not the completed distribution-board configuration.
drawingChecklist: Identify each enclosure and adjoining face.
Include connection flanges, mounting parts and doors.
Reserve door travel and outgoing cable space.
distinction: A collection of empty enclosures is not the completed distribution-board configuration.
